title: Kuro-chan
text: “Alright, let’s go!”
My father reached out for the hand I held out to him. I took his hand and helped him to his feet.
“Motoyasu, you…”

Itsuki glared at me as if at a loss for words. No matter how hard he glares, this Motoyasu won’t back down a single step. For the sake of world peace, for my father, and for Filo-tan, this Motoyasu will keep fighting. Even if my opponents are Itsuki, Ren, or even a god, I won’t lose.
“Don’t believe a word that Bitch standing next to you says, Itsuki.”

It seemed Itsuki didn’t believe a single word of my story about coming from the future. Ren watched Itsuki and me with a look of half-belief, half-doubt. Leaving the two of them behind, I took Father’s hand and left the castle.
“Thank you, Kitamura-kun!”
Once we left the castle and reached the square, my Father expressed his gratitude. I had saved him from the Crimson Swine’s conspiracy.
“Kitamura-kun… To be honest, I used to find you a bit difficult to deal with. But you believed in me, didn’t you?”
“Well, I am The Love Hunter who came from the future, after all. Of course everything my Father says is right!”
With an expression I’d never seen on his face before, my father scratched his head, looking slightly embarrassed, as he thanked me. To be thanked by Filo-tan’s father—what a tremendous honor!
“So, Father, I have a favor to ask.”
Come to think of it, I believe he used to call me “Motoyasu” without the honorific when we first met, but it feels a bit distant now. In that case…
“I’d really like it if you’d call me Motoyasu without the honorific.”
“Eh…”
My father looked a bit flustered. It should be natural for him to call me by my first name, since I’m his son-in-law.
“Is something wrong?”
“No, it’s just… it feels a bit odd to be so familiar with someone who’s put their trust in me.”
“I’d be happy if you just called me that without worrying about it.”
“R-really? W-well then, Motoyasu…-kun.”
“The ‘-kun’ is unnecessary.”
“Um… Sorry. I’ll drop the ‘-kun’ once I get used to it.”

My father replied, sounding as if he were holding back. Hmm… I’d actually be happier if he called me in a more scolding, familiar way. Thinking that, I stared intently at my father. He was wearing only his undershirt.

Come to think of it, that Crimson Swine still stripped me of everything! What should I do? Should I go kill that Crimson Swine right now and take it all back? Yeah. I’ll do that. I’m sure my Father will smile and praise me for it. That’s just the kind of person he is.
“Please wait a moment.”
“Ah, wait a second.”
Just as I was about to head back to the castle, my Father called out to me. He had a look on his face that seemed both troubled and worried.
“What’s wrong?”
“Why are you going back to the castle?”

“Hahaha, what are you talking about? I’m going to kill that red pig and get back everything my Father took from me. Don’t worry, I’ll be right back. If Itsuki or Ren get in my way, I’ll beat them up—but not hard enough to kill them. Justice is on my side!”
“Huh!? Ah, um, Motoyasu-kun. It’s okay now… yeah.”

My father, his face a mask of utter astonishment, answered with a distant look in his eyes. He’s as kind as can be, but it feels a bit half-hearted, doesn’t it? I can’t believe this is the same person who had the Faubrey Pig King deliver the Crimson Swine. I see—so this is the true, gentle side of my father. That must be why Filo-tan grew up to be such a wonderful angel. However, as for me, Motoyasu, my murderous intent toward the Crimson Swine won’t be quelled by something so trivial.
“Is that so? Right now, I could kill him on the spot—that Trash, Kuzvich, who’s a scourge on that world.”
“Enough already… I get it—Motoyasu-kun has incredible power, and you trust me. But… it’s okay now.”
“How kind of you. I, Motoyasu, can’t stop crying at your mercy, Father.”
“Um, please stop saying things like that in a crowded place!”
As I shed tears and saluted my Father, passersby were looking at us, tilting their heads in confusion. Hmm, it looks like I’m about to put Father through some unnecessary embarrassment.
“However… Father. Being in just your underwear is unacceptable.”
“But they took all my money, too.”
“It’s all right. Please use my money.”
“Huh? Is that okay!?”

I handed my money pouch to Father. My father-in-law opened the pouch and replied as if he couldn’t believe it. “It’s a bit lighter since I bought Filolial-sama’s egg, but there’s still a decent amount left.”
“Why bring that up now? We’re family, aren’t we?”
“But what will you do, Motoyasu, once this money runs out?”
“Hahaha, no problem at all.”
“No… seriously, what are you going to do?”
“Hahaha.”
“Don’t just laugh it off. Um… thanks. I’ll just borrow half.”
With that, my father took half the money from my money pouch and returned the rest to me. Just as I’d expect from my father. He’s so humble.
“Well then, let’s go buy some armor for you!”
“U-uh-huh.”
Taking my father-in-law with me, I made my way through the castle town in the morning. There, we ran into the old man who ran the weapon shop—a guy my father-in-law was good friends with.
“Hey, Shield-An-chan.”
“Ugh…”
My father looked flustered as the weapon shop owner glared at him. On the spot, I stepped in front of him to shield him.
“I heard you tried to rape one of your own. Let me punch you once.”
“That’s not true!”
“Huh? Who are you? Judging by that spear, are you the so-called ‘Spear Hero’?”
“That’s right. But you’ve got one thing wrong. My Father didn’t rape anyone!”
“I’m not talking to you. I’m talking to An-chan.”
“I… didn’t do it.”
The Father looked away and answered, sounding irritated. The weapon shop owner glared at the Father for a moment, then relaxed as if letting out a sigh.
“Well, you’re right. An-chan of the Shield isn’t the type to suddenly do something like that.”
“You believe me!?”
“Of course. If anything, she seemed more suspicious to me. After years of dealing with customers, you just get a feel for these things.”
“Dad…”
“Besides… what’s up with committing a crime and only taking the inner armor? Normally, if you had a hunch you were about to get caught, you’d run away first, right?”
“You’re right.”
“So? What about the clothes?”
“Here’s the money.”
With that, I handed the money pouch to the gun shop owner.
“I’d like you to use this money to pick out some armor worthy of my Father.”
“Motoyasu-kun. That’s your money…”
“Hahaha.”
“Don’t try to brush it off with a laugh.”
“Well, how should I put it… It’s great to see you two getting along so well.”
With that, the weapon shop owner cheerfully returned to his shop and selected some armor befitting Father.
“Is chain mail okay? An-chan had a rough time, too. I’ll throw this in for free.”
“No… it’s fine.”
My father refused the chain mail in a fed-up tone and put on a leather suit of armor instead. Perhaps he’s just reluctant to wear something similar to what was stolen.
“Is that so?”
“Motoyasu, I’ll give this money back to you, then.”
My father dutifully accepted his change from the shopkeeper and handed me the money pouch he’d been carrying.
“You really don’t need to worry about it.”
“But I am worried about it.”
“So? What are you and An-chan going to do now?”
“I’m already strong, so I’ll help Father get stronger while I’m at it.”
“Wouldn’t that cause friction between two heroes?”
“Now that you mention it, you’re right… But we can share weapon materials.”
“Is that so? Well then, if Motoyasu gathers the materials and I try the enhancement methods you taught me, I should be able to fight to some extent, right?”
“I think that’ll do for now.”
“Yeah. Then let’s stick together for a while.”
“Yes! As you command, Father.”
I bowed my head to my Father and swore my loyalty. At that, my Father looked troubled and took a few steps back.
“Motoyasu, seriously, stop it!”
“An-chan, you’re getting along with some weirdos…”
“The misunderstandings just keep piling up…”
My father muttered with a sigh. Just as we were having this conversation, the egg and incubator I’d been keeping warm in my coat began to tremble.
“Hmm…”
I took out the incubator and placed it on the shop counter.
“Huh? Did you buy a monster egg, Spear Guy?”
“Yes. It’s an egg from Filolial-sama.”
“Oh, that bird that pulls the carriage?”
“Yes. It’s the same divine bird as Filo-tan.”
“Huh… So this is really the monster Motoyasu-kun likes, huh?”
“Yes!”
As I watched the trembling egg, a crisp crack appeared, and it hatched.
“Peep!”
With a lively chirp, Filolial-sama poked its head out. …It’s black… It turned out to be a male Filolial-sama.
“Peep!”
The monster mark has already been registered. Monsters kept as pets are marked even before they’re born. You could say it’s a mark that symbolizes the bond between me and Filolial-sama.
“Wow… he’s cute. Motoyasu…-kun? Why do you look so disappointed?”
“I’m not disappointed.”
It wasn’t Filo-tan, was it? But there’s nothing I can do about it. I brought my finger close to Filolial-sama and gently stroked his throat.
“Piiii…”
“Your name is… let’s see. Let’s call you Kuro-chan.”
“Is that because of the color? That’s a bit too obvious…”

My Father is saying something. Since I’ll end up buying a lot of them to find Filo-tan, and since this is a black Filolial-sama, I think this name fits best. But if my Father doesn’t like it, another name would be fine too.
“If my Father doesn’t like it… well, how about we call her Black Thunder?”
“That’s a bit much… You’re right, Kuro-chan might actually be the best choice.”
“Pii!”
And so, it was decided that this little one would be Kuro-chan. She’ll surely grow up to be a lively little angel.
“Now we have a new companion.”
“Isn’t she a pet?”
“Filolial-sama is a very reliable companion. No, she’s family!”
“Motoyasu-kun, you’re amazing in so many ways.”
“Anyway, I, Motoyasu, will do my best to help my Father and raise Filolial-sama.”
“Well, do your best, An-chan and Spear-Bro.”
“Yeah. Let’s give it our all from here on out.”
“Alright, let’s get going!”
“Pee!”
With Filolial-sama perched on my hand, we left the castle town behind.
